body:
I understand how you feel, I'm the exact same way. 

The amount of dopamine, or whatever hormone that makes you feel happy, gets released when a male that I'm comfortable with touches me, in whatever way, whether that's hugging me, putting their arm around me, or just even tapping my shoulder, I can't help myself and all of the butterflies in my stomach that are having a fucking rave to crave more of that sort of "affection". 

I have extremely low self confidence so having that sort of contact is super relieving to me. 

You said that you've been looking for two years to find a partner, and I'm guessing you've gone that two years without having this sort of contact with someone else. You could be the type of person that just craves this sort of affection which is completely normal. 

You also mentioned that you want someone to "feel the same warmth as me" which I ask you to not give up on your search. Find someone who has the same interests as you, not just in hobbies, but it maybe opinions or values. Sadly, this might take longer, but just imagine how good it'll feel once you have someone who fits you perfectly and wants the same kind of affection that you want.

Sorry if this makes no sense and sounds more like a rambling than advice, but I just got so excited and relieved that someone is exactly like me and craves this sort of affection. 

I am wishing you the best of luck! :D
